remarks: Welcome to your beautifully renovated new home!  This stunning apartment has been fully updated with brand-new stainless steel appliances, modern countertops, and a newly renovated bathroom. The apartment and home has recently been painted and the driveway has been refreshed.  The unit features two spacious bedrooms, each offering generous storage space. For even more room to organize, you'll find three additional closets in the hallway!  The flexible bonus room can serve as a den, home office, or play area to suit your lifestyle.  Step outside to your private back deck, the perfect spot to relax and unwind after a busy day.  For added convenience, there is a shared laundry room in the basement for all tenants to use.  This unit also comes equipped with a Ring camera for added security, which you'll have full control and access to.  Additional Details:    Utilities: Tenant responsible for electric and gas. Water is covered by the landlord.    Pets: Non-aggressive pets welcome with a $50/month pet fee per pet.    Renters Insurance: Required. Min. credit score 620. 2.5 times rent to income ratio preferred.    Parking: One parking spot is included at no extra charge on the driveway, with additional parking available on the street.
